_comment: D5.3 STREAM 1 of 4 — the human-decision stream, verified by scripts/adapter-evidence-check.mjs itself (activation_source `adapter-evidence`). It carries ONE control and one mechanism, which is finding F4's correction made arithmetic: the release-hold refusal that used to stand in for 'a human authentically decided' cannot reach this claim, because a record naming HG-0002 is refused here as a borrow (AD-R13). No `activation_evidence` block: activation is observed, never declared, and a block filled in by hand with no verified observation behind it is AD-R09.
capability: An authenticated, subject-bound human decision taken on the collaboration surface arrives in the repository as a signed attestation, and the surface refuses the four things it must refuse

evidence._max_age_days: TIGHTER than the 7-day seam default, which is the only direction an adapter may move it (AD-R06). A decision surface is re-pointed by whoever administers the workspace, and three days is how long this institution is willing to believe an unrepeated observation of it.
evidence._observes_identities: The identities this stream makes a claim ABOUT — the bridge transcribes decisions, so an observation signed by it is self-attestation (AD-R19) and it is refused as an observer whatever the record credits.
